name: booharness-mcp-vendor
description: Pinned MCP servers every runtime and every Paseo member launches by absolute path. NOT npx: a member's CLI puts a project-scope server whose command is `npx` into `pending approval` and never exposes its tools - measured 2026-08-03 on claude 2.1.220, four servers in one generated .mcp.json, only the npx one pending. A local file is also one fewer network fetch on the member's critical path.
